name: Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race
short_description: A full marathon and multi-distance race in Hanoi, Vietnam, held November 8, 2026, with the event village at Thong Nhat Park.
ai_summary: The Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race is a full-marathon event scheduled for November 8, 2026, in Hanoi, Vietnam. Organized by DHA Vietnam with Standard Chartered as title sponsor, the race offers distances from a 2.1km Kid Dash to the full 42.195km marathon. The 2026 event runs from 6 to 8 November, with the event village at Thong Nhat Park; in 2025 adult entry in the Standard phase cost VND 800,000 to 2,000,000.

core_facts.venue: Thong Nhat Park (2026 event village), Hanoi

pros: Marathon route through the Old Quarter, past Dong Xuan Market and the Mausoleum
Water and first aid every 2.5 to 3 km, with 21 medical stations in 2025
Fast international front: the 2025 marathon was won in 2:21:57
Full chip-timed results from Sportstats for every distance
Choice of marathon, half, 10 km, 5 km and a Kid Dash
cons: 2am marathon start, in rain and 100% humidity in 2025
Six-hour marathon limit under the 2026 rules, tighter than the 6:48 slowest finish in 2025
The half and 10 km do not enter the Old Quarter
2026 route, start and finish not yet published; the organiser promises a new route
No refunds; transfers cost VND 300,000 in 2025

faqs.question: What distances are offered?
faqs.answer: The event offers five distance options to suit different runners: a 2.1km fun run, a 5km race, a 10km race, a 21.0975km half marathon, and the primary 42.195km full marathon. This range allows participants of varying fitness levels and experience to take part in the same event.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register?
faqs.answer: Adult fees in the 2025 Standard phase (1 July to 27 August 2025) were VND 800,000 for the 5 km, 1,200,000 for the 10 km, 1,600,000 for the 21 km and 2,000,000 for the 42 km. Groups of three or more received 35% off and Standard Chartered cardholders 20% off. Check the official site for 2026 prices.

faqs.question: Where does the race take place?
faqs.answer: The 2026 event runs from 6 to 8 November in Hanoi, with the main race day on 8 November and the event village at Thong Nhat Park. The organiser has promised a new route and has not yet published the start and finish; in 2025 all distances started and finished at Quan Ngua Sports Complex.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: The race is organized by DHA Vietnam, with Standard Chartered serving as the title sponsor. This partnership is reflected in the event's name, the Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race, scheduled to take place on November 8, 2026.
